extension.summary: Sermons and revival preaching from SermonIndex.net
extension.description:
Browse and listen to more than 36,000 sermons from over 2,100 preachers, drawn from the SermonIndex.net archive.
Browse by speaker or by book of the Bible, or let it pick something at random. Audio and video are both included, with subtitles where they exist.
Media streams from the Internet Archive by default, so the addon costs the SermonIndex project nothing to run. A setting lets you switch to the SermonIndex CDN if the Archive is slow where you are.
SermonIndex.net is a non-profit work whose assignment is to honour and preserve the past preaching of God's Word, and to promote revival to this generation. Free to use, no account, no advertising.
extension.news: v1.0.0 — first release. Browse by speaker and by scripture, random sermon, audio and video, subtitles where available.
